options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: cpc_name
options.description: The name of the CPC associated with the target storage group.

options.name: discover_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for how long to wait for completion of the FCP discovery for O(state=discover).

options.name: discover_wait
options.description: Boolean that controls whether to wait for completion of the FCP discovery for O(state=discover).

options.name: expand
options.description: Boolean that controls whether the returned storage group contains additional artificial properties that expand certain URI or name properties to the full set of resource properties (see description of return values of this module).

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the target storage group.

options.name: properties
options.description: Dictionary with desired properties for the storage group. Used for O(state=present); ignored for O(state=absent|facts). Dictionary key is the property name with underscores instead of hyphens, and dictionary value is the property value in YAML syntax. Integer properties may also be provided as decimal strings. options.name: state
options.description: The desired state for the storage group. All states are fully idempotent within the limits of the properties that can be changed, unless otherwise stated: * V(absent): Ensures that the storage group does not exist. If the storage group is currently attached to any partitions, the module will fail (this is an idempotency limitation). * V(present): Ensures that the storage group exists and is associated with the specified CPC, and has the specified properties.
